Name: JP's Trinkets - The Helpers
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][color=#00ff00][size=6][font=Georgia][b][i][u]The Helpers[/u][/i][/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]


[font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]I gave so many little gifts to the villagers in this stinking town, and those bastards never even asked me if I needed help with my farm...[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[size=4][font=Georgia][b]Let me introduce you to The Helpers, three new and powerful trinkets that summon fairies specialized in different tasks:[/b][/font][/size]

[font=Georgia]
[size=4][u][i][color=#00ffff]Gathering wood and cutting down trees and logs.[/color][/i][/u][/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/3wYF9C43/Wooda.gif[/img]
[/font]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][font=Georgia][i][u]Gathering stones and large boulders.[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/wjhkhbvj/Minang.gif[/img]
[/font]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][font=Georgia][i][u]Plowing the land and cultivating it in the blink of an eye.[/u][/i][/font][/size][/color]
[font=Georgia][img]https://i.postimg.cc/JhM5KcD7/Farma.gif[/img][/font]
[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=3][b]When you plow 4 rectangular sections of any size, the fairies will get to work and finish plowing the entire rectangle; they will plant seeds if they are available and water them, and if there are crops, they will harvest them as well. [/b][/size][/color][/font]

[list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]The 3 trinkets, like the rest, have levels that are chosen at random when you find one of these powerful artifacts; in total, [color=#ffff00]there are 4 levels available for each trinket[/color].[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00]Each level summons an extra fairy[/color], and the higher the level, the faster they move and work, and the shorter the cooldown between tasks.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]The fairies store the resources they gather during their actions and bring them to you or to the nearest chest. Farming fairies can also take seeds from a chest to plant them in available areas.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]They're quite useful and will help you, especially with the expansions offered by mods![/font][/size][/*]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=4][font=Georgia]Fairies deal the same damage as an unupgraded tool, regardless of the trinket's level.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]To break through large obstacles like boulders or stumps, [b][i]you need to have your tools upgraded to the required level[/i][/b]; otherwise, they will simply ignore these obstacles.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]

[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's all there is to it. With GMCM, you can configure aesthetic aspects of the mod, such as the size of the fairies and the number visible, among other things.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]


[b][font=Georgia][i][color=#ff0000][size=5][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; you don't need to ask my permission.
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods. [color=#00ffff](Recommended)[/color]
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]


[/font][/b]
